description: Someone who joined the Just-listed email list. The Just-listed email goes to everyone here who hasn't unsubscribed, in the language they signed up in.

id.label: ID
id.help: Made automatically: the time it was sent plus a random part, so the Thanks page address doesn't carry the visitor's name and can't be guessed.

lang.label: Language
lang.help: The language they signed up in. Their emails come in it.

towns.label: Towns of Interest
towns.help: Optional. The towns they care about, one per line.

unsubscribed.label: Unsubscribed
unsubscribed.help: Turned on when they click Unsubscribe in an email. They get no more Just-listed emails. Turn it off only if they ask to rejoin.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
